style: cute chibi animal mascot game character, big round head about 2.5 heads tall, soft clean toon shading, thick dark outline, warm saturated palette

who.rabbit: white rabbit with long upright ears with pink insides, small pink nose, rosy cheeks, light blue scarf
who.cat: orange tabby cat with darker orange stripes, white muzzle and paws, green collar with a small gold bell
who.bear: brown bear cub with round ears, cream muzzle and belly, red hoodie
who.fox: orange fox with white chest and white tail tip, big fluffy tail, small green backpack straps
who.owl: round brown owl with big yellow eyes, cream belly feathers, small round glasses, wings shaped like arms
who.penguin: little penguin, black back and head, white belly and face, orange beak and feet, yellow knitted beanie
who.dragon: small friendly green baby dragon, cream belly, tiny wings on the back, little rounded horns, short tail

pose.tpose: standing in a T-pose, both arms stretched straight out horizontally to the sides, legs slightly apart, facing the camera

framing: front view, full body with both feet visible, single isolated character, centered, about 10% margin on every side
bg: plain flat single-color light gray background, no floor, no shadow on the background, no gradient
neg: no text, no logo, no watermark, no props, no other characters
